bound_basis: Source Multifit02 nonnegative A/B/K/c_s0 and signed gamma; finite computational ranges declared before fitting, not measured physical priors. c_s0 kg/m3; gamma K; other coefficients dimensionless. No probability distributions assigned.
optimizer: scipy.optimize.least_squares TRF; log10 coordinates for K_ref/A1/A2, linear gamma/B1/B2; all coordinates scaled to [0,1]; c_s0 analytically profiled
identifiability: After F starts 1/2, central/one-sided local Jacobian of amplitude-profiled 90 training predictions at best fit, scaled coordinate step 0.001. Fix kinetic columns with weighted full-coordinate derivative norm below 0.01 pp to source values. If singular ratio <1e-4, remove kinetic column with largest weakest-vector loading until ratio passes or nuisance-only remains. One simultaneous reduction, starts 3/4 refit. These local diagnostics are not Sobol ST or proof of global identification. No bootstrap or parameter CI; unknown assay covariance prevents calibrated CIs.
spatial_rule: Training-only: per-window allowance 2*abs(N800-N400)+abs(N200-N400); maximum becomes a common F prediction allowance, minimum 1e-8 pp. Check finest change smaller than coarse change in weighted RMS. Report budget compliance independently from ranking resolution.
optimization_rule: Keep all same-final-parameter-set starts with training objective within 1% of best. Freeze their evaluation predictions before any score; report worst-case paired gain ranges over these training-admissible fits. Report all starts and failures.
uncertainty: Between-shot SD at differing actual windows; paired whole-shot and whole-condition deletion without refitting. Not CIs. Assay/calibration/recovery/mass/window/training/campaign uncertainty unknown, not zero. Numerical allowances are separate. No practical adequacy tolerance.
